changelog: BIM-Bot v2.3.1 — Fixes Claude auto-connect on every real installation. The plugin resolved the install root one folder above BIMBotPlugin.dll, but per-Revit-year builds put it two levels down, so "Connect Claude" and the startup self-heal could never find the MCP server and silently did nothing. The service also no longer depends on port 8080 being free: it moves to the next free port and publishes it, so Revit commands work on machines where another app owns 8080. Corrupt or BOM-prefixed client configs are now backed up and rebuilt instead of abandoned, Claude Desktop is configured even when installed after BIM-Bot, and Revit is detected on non-default drives. Adds scripts/bimbot-doctor.ps1 to diagnose and repair an install in one pass.
